name: CobbleTower
description: The definitive Roguelike Double Battle Tower experience for Cobblemon & CobbleVerse! Features 100 progressive floors, Solo 6v6 & Co-op Duo (3+3) Double Battles, full competitive AI with 6x31 IVs & optimized EVs, cinematic Boss Floor cutscenes, BP Exchange Shop, Hall of Fame Leaderboard, Prestige Ascension, and Post-Battle Grade evaluations.
